SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY No. 900/38 Date 3 / 16 / 41）

S. 1, Special Branch __________ File No. __________ Date December 1, 1941.

SUBJECT: Brewda et al

With reference to attached letter from the Deputy Marshal, U.S. Consulate General, I have to report the following:-

BREWDA, Newach,
Age 27, Polish,
c/o Hicem,
P.O. Box 1425.
Oppenheim Bros & Co.
Shanghai.
No record

BYTENSKI, Nochem,
Age 54, Polish,
c/o Hicem,
P.O. Box 1425,
wife: Dushka.
No record

GERO, Katharina,
Age 60, Czech.,
173 Chusan Road.
arrived from Dairen
on March 30th, 1941.
No record

MAI, Doris M.,
Age 55, British,
c/o Wheelock & Co., Ltd.,
Shanghai.
Arrived from Tientsin
on August 28th.
No record

MAY, Joan D.,
Age 15, British,
address as same above.
No record

（左侧手写批注：Letter to the Immigration Officer, American Consulate General 1. 12. 41 E.L.）

（左侧印章：SPECIAL BRANCH 1 DEC 1941 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

R. W. Mac Lile.
D. S. I.

A.C. (Special Branch).
